reasons: Aggregation differs: Datadog sum:nginx.connections.idle sums across series, but the candidate wraps the selector in avg(), which yields a per-series mean instead of the total.

Template variable $host (prefix host, default *) is dropped; it should become a matcher like host_name=~"$host" (label name to verify against the dataset), so the candidate covers all series rather than the filtered set.
Series set differs as a consequence of the missing host matcher and the avg aggregation.

Quantity mapping idle to state="waiting" on nginx.connections_current is plausible (both count idle keepalive connections) and the metric is a non-monotonic sum with no rate needed, so the metric choice is acceptable.
Outcome translated is appropriate since an exact translation exists; only the aggregation and host filter need fixing.
